_help: HOW TO ADD DIALOGUE: append an entry to 'sequences'. Each sequence has an id, a trigger and a list of lines.
cards_left / cards_drawn count the draw pile (deck); cards_drawn counts from when the dealer finishes dealing. A sequence plays once and sequences that trigger together are queued.
A 'manual' sequence never starts by itself; include it from another sequence with a line like { "play_sequence": "shuffle" }, or the code starts it (see below).
Speakers: dealer = Dian, left_npc = Melanie, right_npc = Flynn, knight, and 'player' for your internal thoughts.
Line fields: speaker (a DialogueSpeaker speaker_id, or 'player' for internal thoughts), text (put *asterisks* around words to show them in bold), and optionally
look_at (a speaker_id or 'player': the speaker looks at them while the line plays and they glance back; add "look_back": false to stop that),
audio (res:// path to a clip; it plays from the speaker and the line stays up for the length of the clip), delay (seconds before the line),
duration (override the line length), pause (seconds after the line). Without audio the length is estimated from the text.

event (runs a table action when the line starts: 'shuffle_deck', 'deal_hands', 'wait_for_drain', 'collect_and_deal', 'start_final_phase', 'speed_up_npcs' (the computer players play faster), 'slow_down_npcs' (back to normal speed), 'wait_for_game_end', 'begin_ending', 'ending_cards_to_candle', 'ending_burn', 'ending_open_door', 'ending_fade_out', 'ending_fade_white' or 'put_cards_down' (everyone lays their cards face down)); add "wait": true to hold the line until it finishes.

Variables: in a line's "speaker" and "look_at", "$name" stands for whoever the code has set with set_variable("name", id); the cheat watcher sets "$complainer" to the owner of the hand you were caught looking at.

Cheating (scripts/cheat_watch.gd): caught_1, caught_2, caught_3 play for each strike (the third ends the game). It plays caught_<strike>_flynn or caught_<strike>_melanie (whoever you were looking at) when that exists. Taking too long (scripts/idle_watch.gd): taking_too_long_0, _1 and _2 are the three things Melanie says (one is picked at random each time) and the last strike plays caught_3_melanie.
Going out (scripts/dealer.gd): when the last cards are being discarded, flynn_goes_out and melanie_goes_out play as each of them runs out of cards.
A line with no text is a silent step: { "event": "wait_for_drain", "wait": true } runs the action and waits for it; { "wait": true } just waits for any action still running.

Sequence options: "disable_play": true stops all players (including you) from playing cards while that sequence runs. "interrupt": true makes it start right after the current line of whatever is playing (which then resumes).
Trigger option: "round": 1 or 2 only lets a cards_left trigger fire in that round (round 2 starts once the dealer has collected the final pile and dealt everyone back up to five).

Ending: 'begin_ending' (scripts/ending_sequence.gd) queues, if unmatched cards remain, unmatched_game_over_<flynn|melanie|player|dian>_wins (or unmatched_game_over_tie) and then unmatched_game_over. If every card is matched it queues all_cards_matched_ending and stealing_ending (the knight's line waits 8 s via its delay so the door is already swinging).

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Welcome back. How'd the table taste?

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: So why'd they make you the dealer?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: If you knew what I've done—

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Don't flatter yourself. We're all in this prison because we're sucky human beings.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: So, how do we play again?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Five cards in hand, no more. Make a set of three and it goes face-up on the table. The player with the most sets wins.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: And what happens when the deck runs out?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: I reshuffle once. We keep going. After the second time, all unmatched cards are passed around. Then, the game is over. Just like they told us...several times.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: And remember, eyes on your own cards.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: The winner leaves and the rest of us are "taken care of".

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: I can't afford to die tonight!

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: I don't think any of us can.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Who made these cards?

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Don't know. They creep me out a little.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Hurry up and give me something!

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: We're all waiting on you.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Just pick a card and get rid of it.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Everyone stop. Time to reshuffle.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: You ever wonder why they set up all this? The candles, the goblet, this whole...place?

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Don't know, don't care. I'm just here to win and get out of here.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: An escape from this prison through competition. That's what it said on the paperwork.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: You read that? I just signed mine. Didn't think anyone actually took the time.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: That's enough chatting, eyes on your cards.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Deck's gone. Passing all my useless cards. Everyone else do the same once your discard pile is expired.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: I'm out, take these suckers.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Game's over. Now what?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: To my dismay, Flynn won.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Ha ha, see ya losers!

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: So what happens now?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Congrats, Melanie.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: I'm free!

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: So what happens now?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Seems like you have the most sets.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: So what happens now?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: As expected, I won.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: So what happens now?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: It is a tie.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: So what happens now?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: We will get rid of the stragglers efficiently.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Wait, it's not supposed to work this way!

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Are all cards matched?

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Yeah, what's the big deal?

lines.speaker: knight
lines.text: You are all free to go...except you. I saw what you did, and I'll admit, I'm impressed...but it's not supposed to work that way either.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Hey, stop looking at my cards!

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: No arguing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I must steal when their *eyes* are not on their own cards.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Hey, stop looking at my cards!

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: No arguing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I must steal when their *eyes* are not on their own cards.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Come on. This is the second time you've looked at our cards!

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Pull that trick again, and you'll wish you hadn't.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Alright, you're done.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Guard!

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Someone's trying to be clever. Let them know it's not supposed to work that way.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Alright, you're done.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Guard!

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Someone's trying to be clever. Let them know it's not supposed to work that way.
